Monster Ability Reference

These 126 monster-only abilities are tools for preparing and adapting creatures. They are separate from learned player abilities, with no DP price or permission to purchase them. A creature gains only the abilities printed in its own entry.

Templates may describe attacker outcomes for construction. During play, use the creature's complete defense-outcome table or the appropriate summoned player profile. Per-creature values and restrictions govern where they specialize a template.

Entries follow in alphabetical order. Their mechanical text comes directly from the authored monster catalog. The assembled reference omits editorial status lines and shared navigation links; it retains every specific action, effect and limit.
